text: oh yeah dont mind them. they are dicking around trying to figure out how to properly save edits with the branch/twig system u can just go in there an hook it up
resolution: Wired the GLB->EditMesh bridge into the Studio so a generated mesh becomes a PAINTABLE model (the user's 'how do I paint it'). Studio.tsx: a top-left '⬇ Import GLB' button opens a new ImportModelDialog that reads a .glb via readFileBase64, runs glbToEditMesh (parse+weld+unwrap), and mints a fresh model (model.newModel()+addPart) — unwrapped so the pixel painter works immediately. Added tools/genmodel: generates a paint-ready GLB (default 800 faces = bigger UV islands for the per-face painter) into cart/hmsc-int/data/generated/ (gitignored), the dialog's default dir. Verified: tools/genmodel 'fire hydrant' wrote a 410v/800f GLB; tsc-check passes; importMesh.test.ts 5/5 + real-GLB probe already proved the conversion. Edited Studio.tsx only after the user stopped the parallel session that was editing it; the final diff is purely the import feature (the other session's branch/twig work was discarded). Committed b96036807 (+ bridge 04bb64cb5). NOT done: live click-path confirmation in the running Studio (headless can't drive the dialog) — for the user; and painting a dense mesh is coarse (per-face islands), so lower --faces helps.
